blocks.title: Evaluation
blocks.body: Assess whether the hotel has a credible independent luxury or upscale proposition and whether Preferred's representation model addresses the owner's commercial objective. Compare with SLH, Design Hotels, and soft-brand alternatives on owner control, distribution, loyalty, standards, and operating implications.

blocks.title: Conversion Design
blocks.body: For a repositioning or opening, protect the hotel's own identity while closing guest-experience gaps that could weaken collection fit. Prioritize product and service work that improves the independent proposition rather than adopting generic brand styling.

blocks.title: Pre-Opening
blocks.body: Coordinate commercial launch planning, property content, channel setup, training, and operator responsibilities with the applicable Preferred program. Confirm timing, technical requirements, and owner versus operator accountabilities before opening so representation and operations launch together cleanly.

blocks.title: Opening
blocks.body: Launch with a consistent independent identity and service delivery that match the promised guest proposition. Use commercial representation as an amplifier, not as a replacement for operating readiness, staffing, or local market activation in the opening window.

blocks.title: Ramp-Up
blocks.body: Review guest feedback, channel mix, and commercial activity against the hotel's own target segment and competitive set each quarter. Adjust programming, sales focus, and service execution without assuming that collection participation alone determines ramp-up performance outcomes for the asset.

blocks.title: Ongoing
blocks.body: Refresh the property's positioning and commercial plan as the market, operator, and guest proposition evolve. Reconfirm membership expectations and program fit before major repositioning, operator change, or renewal decisions so affiliation stays aligned with the asset.

blocks.title: What Owners Are Buying
blocks.body: Preferred Hotels & Resorts gives owners of differentiated independents a representation-led affiliation path that keeps property identity owner-controlled while adding commercial distribution and collection support. The owner proposition is independent luxury or upscale positioning with platform reach—not a conventional hard-brand conversion.

blocks.title: Independent Soft-Brand Conversion
blocks.body: Preferred creates owner value on distinctive independents that need soft-brand credibility and global sales reach without hard-brand homogenization—affiliation fits when local story, design character, and service identity are assets owners want to preserve.

blocks.title: Luxury Boutique Character Stay
blocks.body: Luxury boutique assets suit Preferred when architecture and guest experience are already the product—owners underwrite brand presentation and commercial platform lift carefully so affiliation sharpens demand without forcing prototype standardization.

blocks.title: Destination Resort Soft Affiliation
blocks.body: Destination resorts fit Preferred when place and programming already sell, and the soft brand mainly adds global channels—value holds when PIP, labor, and F&B intensity stay inside underwriting rather than assuming capital-light cutover.

blocks.title: Third-Party Operator-Led
blocks.body: Preferred suits sponsors using operators who balance soft-collection QA with local luxury execution—affiliation lift and financing credibility matter when the property story stays intact and conversion scope is priced for the asset.

blocks.title: Key Watchouts
blocks.body:
Do not underwrite Preferred Hotels & Resorts like a lower-ladder sibling with thinner product capital.
Confirm fee / management exhibits before IC—Factory does not invent undisclosed rates.
Preferred Hotels & Resorts membership network (not a franchise loyalty program) drives demand but adds loyalty chargebacks—model net contribution.
Operator capability must match brand QA intensity for this flag.

blocks.title: Commercial Theme
blocks.body: Versus SLH luxury independent collection, Preferred is a broader independent luxury representation network; versus parent soft brands (Curio / Autograph), Preferred preserves owner control without a parent hard-brand prototype.

blocks.title: Data & Analytics
blocks.body: Parent revenue and CRM analytics support Preferred Hotels & Resorts where connected—property teams still own local competitive response.

blocks.title: International Demand
blocks.body: International feed depends on Preferred Hotels & Resorts membership network (not a franchise loyalty program) awareness and source-market airlift—do not assume global portfolio strength equals this hotel's inbound mix.

blocks.title: Leisure & Destination
blocks.body: Leisure fit follows whether Preferred Hotels & Resorts's product matches destination seasonality and amenity expectations.

blocks.title: Reputation & QA
blocks.body: Guest scores and brand QA affect ranking in Preferred Hotels & Resorts membership network (not a franchise loyalty program) search and account eligibility—budget reputation management.

blocks.title: Sales & Catering
blocks.body: Group and catering contribution depends on meeting product and parent sales coverage for this flag—confirm before underwriting group-heavy IC.

blocks.title: Recent Momentum
blocks.body: Confirm recent Preferred Hotels & Resorts openings and signings from Preferred Hotels & Resorts newsrooms—Factory does not invent opening lists.

blocks.title: Brand / Development Page
blocks.body: Public brand and development references for Preferred Hotels & Resorts. Confirm current PDFs and fee exhibits with Preferred Hotels & Resorts development—do not treat this page as a fee schedule.

blocks.title: Loyalty Program Reference
blocks.body: Official Preferred Hotels & Resorts membership network (not a franchise loyalty program) rules and tier charts — confirm earn/redeem before IC.

blocks.title: Dealality Insight
blocks.body: Preferred fits owners seeking independent luxury representation without franchise prototype economics; fails when soft-brand royalty tables are invented or membership is treated as a hard franchise.
